snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.4 PV | The Forest Need Not Listen
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.4 PV | The Forest Need Not Listen

Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock—
We're late! We're late! For a very important date...
Follow its rules, obey its laws,
How many times must we live this tale? Trapped inside the forest...
Noise! Shouts! Laughter! Cries!
Someone refuses to close their eyes.
Shh—listen... it's her.

Infinity Nikki Version 2.4 "The Forest Need Not Listen" launches on March 26 (UTC-7)!
Get ready, stylists! The upcoming update brings the exclusive quest [The Forest Need Not Listen], the permanent quest [Momo, Grow Stronger!], plus a host of fun new events. More adventures await when the update launches!

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.4 The Forest Need Not Listen launches globally on March 26 (UTC-7)!
